headline: Altman says it's 'terrible' to keep RAM in personal PCs
summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said in a podcast interview that it is 'terrible' or 'quite terrible' for people to keep RAM in their own PCs rather than letting it go to AI data centers, framing it as a poor use of the world's limited DRAM supply. The Verge reports the remark came on the Cheeky Pint podcast, when Altman was asked about supply chain shortages including the ongoing RAM shortage.
